note: Deuteronomy 11:25 — *There shall no man be able to stand before you: for Yahuah Elohaychem (the LORD your God) shall lay the fear of you and the dread of you upon all the land that ye shall tread upon, as he hath said unto you.* The dread Judah expects to fall on the Canaanite kings (Jasher 34:55) is the laid-on fear Moses promises the land.
reason: Note says 'the dread Judah expects to fall on the Canaanite kings (Jasher 34:55)'; 34:55 is the verse that names 'all the Canaanitish kings' delivered into our hands. 34:60 (card) is the call to gird on weapons, 'He will save us', and has no kings. Prose address is right; move the card.
